author: BoldAndBrash
body:
It's the most overpowered kit of them all. You throw a grenade at someone and they either die of fall damage or fall into the void. The grenades are also nearly 1 hit kills. I think we should remove how they make people fly & lessen the amount of damage given.


Feedback.

replies.author: halfrest
replies.body: Yeah. The thing that really separates Fisherman from Demo is that Demo has only 1 use on both items, but Fisherman has alot of uses. From personal experience making vanilla minigames, etc, I know it's extremely hard to control explosion damage. That's understandable, but personally I think the demo should have a recharge (which goes against the idea of it being nerfed, of course), so that the demo could actually SURVIVE after he uses both weapons, because he just gets killed because of his crappy sword after. I think the fishing rod should have a cooldown, also. One thing you could do it randomize the explosion, where there's a radius of 5 blocks that it could fall in, and so there's a chance you could get launched, and another chance that there could be barely any damage at all. The time-bomb function is good, because if I see a tnt being planted, I have about 4-5 seconds to run before it explodes, but I think the grenade should somehow be regulated.
